name: Taco Beef, Potato, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Bake with Cheese & Sour Cream (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 4 mini food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lb new potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice zucchini. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini.
Quarter new potatoes. Add to the baking sheet.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the baking sheet, then drizzle veggies with oil and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
taco seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add water to the skillet with the beef. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened and beef is cooked through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
Divide sour cream between the mini storage containers, cover, and refrigerate.

Divide roasted veggies, taco beef, and cheese between the medium storage containers, then allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat veggies and beef in the oven or microwave, top with sour cream, and enjoy!
